name: Ruins of Loropéni
description: In southern Burkina Faso, near the borders with Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana and Togo, rise the high stone walls of Loropéni, a fortified settlement at least 1,000 years old. It grew rich on the gold trade between the 14th and 17th centuries and was left empty in the early 1800s. Much of it remains unexcavated, so its secrets are still being uncovered.
